summary: Iteration 4 — 3 corrections + regression smoke. ALL PASS. Backend pytest 34/34 (7.92s) via /app/backend/tests/test_api.py including 2 new iter-4 tests: test_iter4_default_moderation_words_seeded (asserts the 6 defaults 'brujeria', 'amuleto', 'maldicion', 'milagro garantizado', 'cadena de oracion', 'reenvia esto' are all present in GET /api/admin/moderation/words as superadmin) and test_iter4_default_filter_flags_brujeria (fresh user posts 'TEST oracion sobre brujeria en el pueblo' → response has flagged=true and intention.status='pending'; the intention id is NOT visible in public GET /api/intentions). NO text clipping, NO layout breakage, NO React Native red screen anywhere. CORRECTION 3 — /app/.env.example verified: file exists and lists MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD, SEED_EDITOR_EMAIL/PASSWORD, SEED_MODERATOR_EMAIL/PASSWORD, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, EXPO_TUNNEL_SUBDOMAIN, EXPO_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME, EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL, EXPO_USE_FAST_RESOLVER, METRO_CACHE_ROOT — all keys empty (no real secret values). REGRESSION smoke: register (TEST_iter4_<uuid>@example.com) → onboarding (saint_corazon) → Altar rendered with 'Buenas tardes, TEST' greeting and lit candle SVG; /light-candle deceased-toggle flips rim ellipse fill from #4A0000 (red) → #8A6A2E (amber/mourning) — captured programmatically via SVG ellipse fill inspection; admin login works and Panel de gestión loads for superadmin (Hola, Juan (Superadmin)); all core backend endpoints (auth/login, /candles, /intentions, /causes/current, /masses/next, /transparency, /saints, /daily) return 200 via pytest. Only console noise is the pre-existing RN Web shadow*/Image.resizeMode deprecation warnings from iterations 1-3 — non-blocking, already reported.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Migrate remaining RN shadow* style props to boxShadow and move Image resizeMode from StyleSheet to <Image resizeMode=... /> prop to silence the two RN Web deprecation warnings.
